colors.title: Colors
colors.intro: The color system separates component-facing semantic tokens from the Sass primitives that provide their values.
colors.semanticIntro: Components should consume these CSS custom properties through var(--token) instead of using primitive values directly.
colors.reservedIntro: Official values in src/styles/_primitives.scss for upcoming Tabs, Badge, and state styles. Not published as CSS custom properties yet.

--color-text-default.title: Text default
--color-text-default.description: Default color for text and icons.

--color-text-on-emphasis.title: Text on emphasis
--color-text-on-emphasis.description: Text and icons placed on emphasized surfaces.

--color-surface-emphasis.title: Surface emphasis
--color-surface-emphasis.description: Selected tab and other emphasized surfaces.

--color-border-outline-focus.title: Border outline focus
--color-border-outline-focus.description: Outline border when a control has keyboard focus.

$color-border-muted.title: Border muted
$color-border-muted.description: Hover and active borders, including tab underlines.

$color-surface-muted.title: Surface muted
$color-surface-muted.description: Neutral badges and the pressed background of an unselected pill.

typography.title: Typography
typography.intro: Typography styles provide consistent hierarchy and rhythm across interface content.
typography.usage: Heading is used for page and section titles. Body is used for regular text. Button is used for clickable nodes, including tabs.
typography.presets: The Sass presets are heading-m, heading-s, body-m, body-s, button-m, and button-s. CircularXX is used for headings and Inter for body and button styles; both include system fallbacks until font delivery is added.

styles.heading-m: Invented for Storybook documentation page headings; not part of the official specification.
styles.heading-s: Invented for Storybook documentation section headings; not part of the official specification.
styles.body-m: Default text for paragraphs and interface content.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.intro: Official scale from the Spacings board (4XS through 2XL).
spacing.note: Only a subset is exposed in :root today. Add a token when a second component needs the same spacing role.

breakpoints.title: Breakpoints
breakpoints.intro: Official viewport switch from the Components board.
breakpoints.upcoming: Tab heights, padding, and gaps per variant will use these breakpoints when component styles are implemented.
